good_thing: (Tulsa, Oklahoma): Tulsa Animal Services finished its August Clear the Shelters campaign with 509 adoptions, passing its 500-animal goal. It recorded 647 positive outcomes overall, including 75 transfers to rescue partners and 63 reunions with families. The shelter director had promised to dye her hair if adoptions reached 500, so there is a cheerful encore to come.
current_or_history: On September 2, 1752, Britain and its American colonies had their last day under the Julian calendar. The next day was Thursday, September 14, as eleven dates were skipped to adopt the Gregorian calendar. Parish registers still had to carry on recording the ordinary business of births, marriages, and deaths through a suddenly shorter month.
tiny_fact: The smallest book held by the Library of Congress is “Old King Cole.” It measures one twenty-fifth of an inch by one twenty-fifth of an inch, roughly the size of the period at the end of this sentence.
thought: A small improvement still counts, even if it arrives wearing temporary purple hair.
